title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
summary: Olaf Ronneberger, Philipp Fischer and Thomas Brox submitted U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation on May 18, 2015. The paper presents a convolutional-network architecture with a contracting path for context and a symmetric expanding path for precise localization, together with extensive data augmentation for training from comparatively few annotated biomedical images.
significance: A documented research milestone for U-Net and biomedical image segmentation, recorded at the original paper-submission level rather than as an invention, development-start, software-release, institutional-origin or universal-priority claim.

verification.note: The authors' arXiv record supports the title, authors, May 18 2015 submission date and the described contracting/expanding architecture and data-augmentation strategy. The University of Freiburg lab's U-Net project and publication pages independently corroborate the paper identity, authorship, 2015 MICCAI publication context and architecture description. The day-precision date is attached specifically to the arXiv submission milestone. It is not asserted as an invention date, development-start date, software-release date, institutional-origin date or universal-priority date. No geography, ancestry, influence or causality is inferred.
